admin.mute: [Administrator] Mute the user you replied to (default: 1h)
admin.unmute: [Administrator] Unmute the user you replied to
admin.purge: [Administrator] Ban the user you replied to and delete all messages
admin.ban: [Administrator] Ban and remove the user you replied to
admin.warn: [Administrator] Warn the user you replied to (removed after %[1]d warnings)
admin.clear_warn: [Administrator] Clear warnings for the user you replied to
admin.name_spoiler: [Administrator] Toggle name hiding for new members

owner.console_denied: Only the account bound when this instance was deployed can open the console, and nothing is bound yet. The binding link is printed to the service log on every start, on the line beginning OWNER UNCLAIMED; restart the process to print a fresh one.
owner.console_sent: One-time link, good once and only for you.
owner.console_local: This console listens on the loopback interface, so it opens only from the machine it runs on. Forward the port, then open:

direct_message.auto_reply:
👋 %[2]s

• To join: submit a join request in the group. Answer a challenge sent here, or select “✅ Start verification” in any group message the bot posts.
• Lookup commands also work in direct messages; /help lists every one of them. Direct messages are limited to %[1]d queries per minute; group chats are not rate-limited.
• Review and administration commands only work in the group.
direct_message.identity: This bot handles join verification and provides Linux lookup commands for its configured groups.

registration.owner_claimed: Deployer ownership is now bound to this account. You can add groups.
registration.owner_claim_refused: That owner link is not valid: it was used, or it expired. A fresh one is printed to the service log every time the process starts, on the line beginning OWNER UNCLAIMED.
registration.owner_claim_save_failed: Could not save the owner claim. Restore write access to the service state directory, then retry the same link.
registration.enrollment_owner_only: Only the bot owner can create group-enrollment links.
registration.enrollment_link:
Group-enrollment link (valid for %[1]d minutes and one use):
%[2]s
registration.enrollment_refused: This group-enrollment link is invalid, used, or expired. The bot will leave this group.
registration.registration_pending: Registration is authorized for group “%[1]s”. Promote the bot to administrator and grant the required permissions. Registration finishes automatically after promotion.
registration.group_registered: Registered group “%[1]s”. Run /settings in that group.
registration.registration_save_failed: Could not persist group registration. The bot will leave this group; check the service state directory.
registration.unregister_owner_only: Only the bot owner can unregister runtime groups.
registration.unregister_refused: Could not unregister that group. Use /unregister <group-id> with a runtime-registered group ID.
registration.unregister_save_failed: Could not persist group removal. Restore write access to the service state directory, then retry.
registration.group_unregistered: Unregistered group “%[1]s” and removed its runtime settings.

setup.title: Claim this instance
setup.description: The script has finished its part on this machine. The rest is filled in here, so no credential reaches your shell history.
setup.token_required: A Telegram bot token is required.
setup.claimed: This instance is claimed and the bot is running.
setup.binding: Open this link in Telegram to bind the deployer account.
setup.step_console_note: The one-time link the install script printed has handed this console to you.
setup.step_token_note: Asked for here rather than on the terminal, so it stays out of shell history and out of the scrollback.
setup.step_binding_note: The bot exists only once the token is accepted, so only from here on can it receive a private passphrase.
setup.step_group_note: The instance waits for the group to appear, then checks each permission the bot needs.
setup.token_hint: Ask @BotFather in Telegram for a bot, then paste the whole line it gives you, including the digits before the colon.
setup.token_rejected: Telegram did not accept this token. Check that the whole line was pasted, including the digits before the colon.
setup.telegram_unreachable: Telegram could not be reached, so the token was never judged. What needs attention is the network or proxy on this machine, not the token.
setup.instance_fault: The token was accepted, but the instance did not start. This is not a token problem; the reason is in the server log.
setup.after_binding: Once the account is bound, add the bot to your first group. The console opens on the group list.

error_page.not_found_description: Either it was mistyped, or it was a one-time link and has already been used. A one-time link stops working the moment it is opened, which is what makes it one-time.
error_page.refused_title: The console will not answer this request
error_page.refused_description: The address exists, but not for this kind of request. Open the console from its own address instead.
error_page.step_manager: Group administrators open the console from %[1]s in Telegram.
error_page.step_operator: Operators ask the bot for a fresh one-time link.
error_page.step_unclaimed: Nobody has claimed this instance yet. Its way in is the one-time link the install script printed.
